claims.statement: plugin/ui/NativeUi.cmake reads T3K_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (required, the OAuth client_id, looks like t3k_pub_...), T3K_API_DOMAIN (default https://www.tone3000.com, trailing slash stripped), and T3K_UPDATE_NOTICE (default false; 'true' → 1) from .env / .env.local at the repo root (configure-environment variables override both), at configure time, and bakes them into the generated T3kConfig.h via configure_file(core/T3kConfig.h.in → build/t3k_ui/T3kConfig.h). Tone3000Session::Config::fromBuild() exposes that pair to the session layer.

Tone3000Client (port of the web app's T3KClient) persists Tokens {access, refresh, expiresAtMs} in UiPrefs JSON on disk so a sign-in from a webview build does not carry over and a signed-in user stays signed in across editor sessions. Proactive refresh: an access token is refreshed automatically when within 60 s of expiry (kRefreshLeadMs = 60_000); concurrent callers share one in-flight refresh (refreshWaiters_). Bearer fetch retries once on 401 (the expiry-check race). Because the prefs file is shared with every other host running the plugin and a refresh rotates the pair, the store is re-read before refreshing and before giving up on a rejected refresh — a pair another host rotated meanwhile is adopted rather than fought. Every reply lands on the message thread; the clock is injectable for tests.

Typed cloud endpoints on Tone3000Client: getUser, getTone(int, Reply), setFavorite(toneId, bool, Reply), listTones(path, Reply) (a ToneQuery::requestPath → PaginatedResponse), listTrending(gear, Reply) (the /tones/trending top-10 feed; Bearer when signed in, anonymous otherwise — the signed-out preview), listTaxonomy(kind, query, pageSize, Reply) (/tags, /makes, /users), listModels(toneId, pageSize, architecture, Reply) (architecture < 0 omits the filter), and fetchPluginVersion(deviceId, localVersion, Reply) (/plugin/version with X-Device-Id and X-Plugin-Version headers, each omitted when empty). Errors carry the web client's codes/messages ('token_refresh_failed', 'getTone failed: 404'; non-2xx → '<label> failed: <status>').

Tone3000Session (port of useToneSession.ts + useT3kSelect.ts) adds three competing sign-in paths, first to finish winning: (1) loopback redirect http://localhost:<port>/ (auto-allowed for publishable keys, via LoopbackServer); (2) copy-URL (JUCE's launch reports success once the launcher forks — not when the browser opens — so the sign-in screen always shows the authorize URL to copy); (3) device flow (RFC 8628) — requestDeviceAuthorization gives deviceCode (never shown), userCode, verificationUri, expiresInS, intervalS; pollDeviceToken reports server codes authorization_pending / slow_down (+5s) / expired_token / access_denied, with 'token_refresh_failed' meaning a transport error. kProbeTimeoutMs = 8000 (port of the web's PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS) — probes time out at 8 s and never alarm on timeout alone. selectTone → fetchToneAndModels hands the tone + first loadable model to the backend for off-thread load.

ConnectionGate (port of useConnectionGate.ts) is the first line of defence for network-dependent actions (add/swap/login). kProbeTtlMs = 30_000 (min gap between background probes); kConfirmDelayMs = 2000 (one transient failure must not raise the alarm). Problem::offline = no OS network interface up → the offline modal opens and the action is queued for 'Try again' (instant, no probe). Problem::insecure = diagnostic, not a gate: only after two consecutive network-layer failures while the OS reports a connection (usually wrong system clock); timeouts are inconclusive and never alarm, and a later successful probe/retry closes the modal. requireConnection(action) never blocks — with the action running now and a throttled background probe checking HTTPS on the side, nothing ever waits on a probe.

UpdateCheck is optional and off by default: only when the build sets T3K_UPDATE_NOTICE=true does it call fetchPluginVersion (a GET to ${T3K_API_DOMAIN}/api/v1/plugin/version with X-Device-Id and X-Plugin-Version headers) once on startup and raise an 'update available' notice when the server's version is newer than the running build's localVersion (which is empty/unknown for forks — that path is skipped). The update check is therefore a build-time decision baked into T3kConfig.h, not a runtime toggle.
